name: 11520 · Freeport, NY
findings: ZIP 11520 (Freeport) has 165 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11520 (Freeport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
